name: 疑惑的蜜桃猫
technique: PNG IEND 尾部附加 RAR5 识别 + bsdtar 解包；ZIP 伪加密本地头/中央目录 flags bit0 双层清除
when_to_use: challenge looks like misc; recall from writeup '疑惑的蜜桃猫'
commands: d = bytearray(open('flag.exe','rb').read()); i = d.find(b'PK\x03\x04'); z = d[i:]
lf = struct.unpack('<H', z[6:8])[0]; z[6:8] = struct.pack('<H', lf & ~1)
cc = z.find(b'PK\x01\x02'); cf = struct.unpack('<H', z[cc+8:cc+10])[0]; z[cc+8:cc+10] = struct.pack('<H', cf & ~1)
